extraction.notes: BRG reports FFO and CFFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. The starting line is net loss attributable to common stockholders; the OP unit add-back is included as the first FFO adjustment. Q2 2022 values shown as '—' are recorded as 0. Diluted shares printed as 41,459,819, entered as 41,459.819 thousand; check: -6,239/41,459.8 = -0.15 and 3,317/41,459.8 = 0.08. The recurring capex figure is six-month YTD only (no quarterly figure found), so basis is year_to_date. The CFFO subtotal foots to 3,317 as printed. Adjustments are signed as printed.
